Novyy Yarychiv Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · L'vivs'ka oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. This record contains a contradiction worth flagging: it is categorized as demolished and overbuilt, yet the source's demolished field marks it as 'no.' Novyy Yarychiv's small Jewish community, present from 1577, was almost entirely killed during Tartar raids the following year. From 1822 to 1837, Rabbi Shalom Halevi Rosenfeld, known as the 'Rava Prodigy,' served as rabbi here; in the 1930s, the Hasidic court of Shmuel Gutsman (1902–1970), a descendant of the Baal Shem Tov, was centered in the town. During the ghetto's liquidation in mid-January 1943, nearly 1,000 people were murdered directly at this cemetery, and another 1,570 in a nearby forest.
